newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf MTBE prices jump as boat loads for NY.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf MTBE prices jump as boat loads for NY.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices jumped in moderate trade in the U.S. Gulf Coast as a major player tried to load a 260,000 barrel cargo for New York Harbor, players said Wednesday.
The player began looking for product in the spot Houston market late last week, pressuring up already snug supplies of prompt barrels.
For barrels to be delivered by June 20, spot MTBE in Houston was pegged two cents higher to between 80.00 cents and 80.25 cents a gallon. An 80.25 cent deal was heard done.
The market is considerably weaker after June 20th delivery, at about 76.00/77.50 cents in Houston.
New York Harbor remained in its nearly two-weeklong trading range of 82.00/82.50 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
